Lesson goal

Understand landing transitions, bike alignment and absorption, and treat the landing and the exit line as one movement.

What it will cover

  • Transition geometry and landing zones
  • Rider and bike alignment through contact
  • Absorption and mobility
  • Landing and exit as one movement
  • Diagnosing harsh, off-axis, nose-heavy or rear-heavy landings from video
  • When to stop, reset or ask a coach to inspect the feature

Safety

Class 2: advanced riding skills. Needs the stated prerequisites, a controlled progression, suitable terrain and coaching guidance.

Practice only on terrain your coach has chosen, within your current skill, with the right protective equipment. Completing a lesson isn’t a safety certificate and doesn’t mean a rider is ready to try anything.
